email.subject1: a signal play for Osa Commerce
email.body1:
Yifat, saw Osa Commerce launched AI-powered retail compliance at Manifest 2026, going after the $5B chargeback problem.

A launch like that usually creates more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps can work them, and that is exactly where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Osa off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Yifat, quick follow-up for Osa Commerce.

With a new compliance product in market, the growth target usually climbs faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to cover the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Osa needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Yifat, last bit of proof for Osa Commerce.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Osa's reply rate likely compares to peer supply-chain-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Yifat, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Bringing a new product to market is its own kind of busy, and I get that timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Osa either way.
